findings.claim: ship.md step 4 ('Anything remote (push, PR) waits for the user's explicit go-ahead') and section 2 (merge-presentation confirmation) are not rescheduled; the main thread still asks in chat before push/PR.
findings.closure: Step 8 schedules the rewrite of ship.md step 4 (no go-ahead for the pass's push/PR when the hook allows them) and section 2 (amended cases go into the PR body; the merge presentation applies to 4bis-local only), and a PK case asserts ship.md outside 4bis-local no longer contains 'waits for the user's explicit go-ahead' or 'in the merge presentation (step 4bis, which every pass reaches)'; it passes.

findings.claim: Close-on-MERGED has no executor (nothing runs loop-pr-state.sh) and ship.md step 5 still moves story/board right after 4bis.
findings.closure: The plan names the command and phase that runs loop-pr-state.sh --chain at session start and schedules its write; ship.md step 5 is rescheduled so board/story move only on closable; a PK case asserts both; it passes.

findings.claim: /loop:small has no way to obtain a record and ship.md's Small-ticket integration still merges locally.
findings.closure: The plan states how a small pass obtains a record and schedules ship.md's Small-ticket integration rewrite to the PR path when a remote exists, with an LP case and a PK needle; or an explicit OUT line for small that the user's go accepts.

findings.claim: github.md's documented push/PR command forms never match the hook's exact grammar; V5 never fires; no case.
findings.closure: Step 8 rewrites github.md's push and PR command lines to the hook's exact forms, and a PK case asserts both literal forms in github.md and ship.md 4bis-PR; it passes.

findings.claim: The rows-print-title amendment contradicts AC5 and V10's row grammar; it is the planner's wording, so the test-plan go cannot record it; it must go through the contract route.
findings.closure: The amendment goes through the contract route (spec V10 row line and AC5 edited, Contract: amended: recorded, plan AC copy updated) and PK27 asserts the title row grammar; or the user keeps hashed rows and Q5's producer closure applies.
